# `skillset new`

> Generated from Skillset's CLI presentation contract. See the [documentation system](../../development/documentation-system.md).

Create a new skill, agent, instruction, or hook in source.

## Usage

```text
skillset new [skill|agent|instruction|hook] [name] [--id <id>] [--name <name>] [--in <container>] [--scope repo] [--preset <preset>] [--event <event>] [--command <command> | --script <path>] [--attach <source-unit>] [--provider <provider>] [--yes] [--json] [--root <path>]
```

## Options

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--attach <value>` | Attach a new adaptive hook to an existing source-unit selector. |
| `--command <value>` | Set the command action for a new adaptive hook. |
| `--event <value>...` | Select a hook event; repeat where the route permits. |
| `--id <value>` | Set an explicit stable source-unit id. |
| `--in <value>` | Select the containing plugin for a new source unit. |
| `--json` | Emit exactly one versioned finite JSON result document. |
| `--name <value>` | Set a route-specific human or stable name where the route permits it. |
| `--preset <value>...` | Apply a named new-source preset. |
| `--provider <value>...` | Constrain a new adaptive hook to a compatible provider. |
| `--root <value>` | Select the repository root; defaults to cwd or Git root according to the route. |
| `--scope <value>...` | Select a route-owned source unit or generated destination scope; never changes workspace roots. |
| `--script <value>` | Set the script action for a new adaptive hook. |
| `--yes` | Confirm a fully specified plan-first mutation without prompting. |
